18 private def ensureValidNamespace (name : Name) : MacroM Unit := do
19   match name with
20   | .str p s =>
21     if s == "_root_" then
22       Macro.throwError s!"invalid namespace `{name}`, `_root_` is a reserved namespace"
23     ensureValidNamespace p
24   | .num .. => Macro.throwError s!"invalid namespace `{name}`, it must not contain numeric parts"
25   | .anonymous => return ()
26 
27 private def setDeclIdName (declId : Syntax) (nameNew : Name) : Syntax :=
28   let (id, _) := expandDeclIdCore declId
29   -- We should not update the name of `def _root_.` declarations
30   assert! !(`_root_).isPrefixOf id
31   let idStx := mkIdent nameNew |>.raw.setInfo declId.getHeadInfo
32   if declId.isIdent then
33     idStx
34   else
35     declId.setArg 0 idStx
36 
37 /-- Return `true` if `stx` is a `Command.declaration`, and it is a declaration that always has a name. -/
38 private def isNamedDecl (stx : Syntax) : Bool :=
39   if !stx.isOfKind ``Lean.Parser.Command.declaration then
40     false
41   else
42     let decl := stx[1]
43     let k := decl.getKind
44     k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.abbrev ||
45     k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.definition ||
46     k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.theorem ||
47     k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.opaque ||
48     k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.axiom ||
49     k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.inductive ||
50     k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.classInductive ||
51     k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.structure
52 
53 /-- Return `true` if `stx` is an `instance` declaration command -/
54 private def isInstanceDecl (stx : Syntax) : Bool :=
55   stx.isOfKind ``Lean.Parser.Command.declaration &&
56   stx[1].getKind == ``Lean.Parser.Command.instance
57 
58 /-- Return `some name` if `stx` is a declaration named `name` -/
59 private def getDeclName? (stx : Syntax) : Option Name := do
60   if isNamedDecl stx then
61     let (id, _) := expandDeclIdCore stx[1][1]
62     some id
63   else if isInstanceDecl stx then
64     let optDeclId := stx[1][3]
65     if optDeclId.isNone then none
66     else
67       let (id, _) := expandDeclIdCore optDeclId[0]
68       some id
69   else
70     none
71 
72 /--
73 Update the name of the given declaration.
74 This function assumes `stx` is not a nameless instance.
75 -/
76 private def setDeclName (stx : Syntax) (name : Name) : Syntax :=
77   if isNamedDecl stx then
78     stx.setArg 1 <| stx[1].setArg 1 <| setDeclIdName stx[1][1] name
79   else if isInstanceDecl stx then
80     -- We never set the name of nameless instance declarations
81     assert! !stx[1][3].isNone
82     stx.setArg 1 <| stx[1].setArg 3 <| stx[1][3].setArg 0 <| setDeclIdName stx[1][3][0] name
83   else
84     stx
85 
86 /--
87   Given declarations such as `@[...] def Foo.Bla.f ...` return `some (Foo.Bla, @[...] def f ...)`
88   Remark: if the id starts with `_root_`, we return `none`.
89 -/
90 private def expandDeclNamespace? (stx : Syntax) : MacroM (Option (Name × Syntax)) := do
91   let some name := getDeclName? stx | return none
92   if (`_root_).isPrefixOf name then
93     ensureValidNamespace (name.replacePrefix `_root_ Name.anonymous)
94     return none
95   let scpView := extractMacroScopes name
96   match scpView.name with
97   | .str .anonymous _ => return none
98   | .str pre shortName => return some (pre, setDeclName stx { scpView with name := .mkSimple shortName }.review)
99   | _ => return none

101 def elabAxiom (modifiers : Modifiers) (stx : Syntax) : CommandElabM Unit := do
102   -- leading_parser "axiom " >> declId >> declSig
103   let declId             := stx[1]
104   let (binders, typeStx) := expandDeclSig stx[2]
105   runTermElabM fun vars => do
106     let scopeLevelNames ← Term.getLevelNames
107     let ⟨shortName, declName, allUserLevelNames, docString?⟩ ← Term.expandDeclId (← getCurrNamespace) scopeLevelNames declId modifiers
108     addDeclarationRangesForBuiltin declName modifiers.stx stx
109     Term.withAutoBoundImplicit do
110     Term.withAutoBoundImplicitForbiddenPred (fun n => shortName == n) do
111     Term.withDeclName declName <| Term.withLevelNames allUserLevelNames <| Term.elabBinders binders.getArgs fun xs => do
112       Term.applyAttributesAt declName modifiers.attrs AttributeApplicationTime.beforeElaboration
113       let type ← Term.elabType typeStx
114       Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
115       let xs ← Term.addAutoBoundImplicits xs (declId.getTailPos? (canonicalOnly := true))
116       let type ← instantiateMVars type
117       let type ← mkForallFVars xs type
118       let type ← mkForallFVars vars type (usedOnly := true)
119       let type ← Term.levelMVarToParam type
120       let usedParams  := collectLevelParams {} type |>.params
121       match sortDeclLevelParams scopeLevelNames allUserLevelNames usedParams with
122       | Except.error msg      => throwErrorAt stx msg
123       | Except.ok levelParams =>
124         let type ← instantiateMVars type
125         let decl := Declaration.axiomDecl {
126           name        := declName,
127           levelParams := levelParams,
128           type        := type,
129           isUnsafe    := modifiers.isUnsafe
130         }
131         trace[Elab.axiom] "{declName} : {type}"
132         Term.ensureNoUnassignedMVars decl
133         addDecl decl
134 
135         Term.applyAttributesAt declName modifiers.attrs AttributeApplicationTime.afterTypeChecking
136         if isExtern (← getEnv) declName then
137           compileDecl decl
138         if let some (doc, isVerso) := docString? then
139           addDocStringOf isVerso declName binders doc
140         Term.applyAttributesAt declName modifiers.attrs AttributeApplicationTime.afterCompilation
141         withSaveInfoContext do  -- save new env with docstring and decl
142           Term.addTermInfo' declId (← mkConstWithLevelParams declName) (isBinder := true)
143         enableRealizationsForConst declName
144 open Lean.Parser.Command.InternalSyntax in
145 /--
146 Macro that expands a declaration with a complex name into an explicit `namespace` block.
147 Implementing this step as a macro means that reuse checking is handled by `elabCommand`.
148  -/
149 @[builtin_macro Lean.Parser.Command.declaration]
150 def expandNamespacedDeclaration : Macro := fun stx => do
151   match (← expandDeclNamespace? stx) with
152   | some (ns, newStx) => do
153     -- Limit ref variability for incrementality; see Note [Incremental Macros]
154     let declTk := stx[1][0]
155     let ns := mkIdentFrom declTk ns
156     withRef declTk `(namespace $ns $endLocalScopeSyntax:command $(⟨newStx⟩) end $ns)
157   | none => Macro.throwUnsupported
158 
159 @[builtin_command_elab declaration, builtin_incremental]
160 def elabDeclaration : CommandElab := fun stx => do
161   withExporting (isExporting := (← getScope).isPublic) do
162   let modifiers : TSyntax ``Parser.Command.declModifiers := ⟨stx[0]⟩
163   let decl     := stx[1]
164   let declKind := decl.getKind
165   if isDefLike decl then
166     -- only case implementing incrementality currently
167     elabMutualDef #[stx]
168   else withoutCommandIncrementality true do
169     -- use hash of declaration name, if any, as stable quot context; `elabMutualDef` has its own
170     -- handling
171     withInitQuotContext (getDeclName? stx |>.map hash) do
172     let mut modifiers ← elabModifiers modifiers
173     if (← getScope).isMeta && modifiers.computeKind == .regular then
174       modifiers := { modifiers with computeKind := .meta }
175     withExporting (isExporting := modifiers.isInferredPublic (← getEnv)) do
176       if declKind == ``Lean.Parser.Command.«axiom» then
177         elabAxiom modifiers decl
178       else if declKind == ``Lean.Parser.Command.«inductive»
179           || declKind == ``Lean.Parser.Command.«coinductive»
180           || declKind == ``Lean.Parser.Command.classInductive
181           || declKind == ``Lean.Parser.Command.«structure» then
182         elabInductive modifiers decl
183       else
184         throwError "unexpected declaration"
185 
186 /-- Return true if all elements of the mutual-block are definitions/theorems/abbrevs. -/
187 private def isMutualDefLike (stx : Syntax) : Bool :=
188   stx[1].getArgs.all fun elem =>
189     let decl := elem[1]
190     isDefLike decl
191 
192 private def isMutualPreambleCommand (stx : Syntax) : Bool :=
193   let k := stx.getKind
194   k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.variable ||
195   k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.universe ||
196   k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.check ||
197   k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.set_option ||
198   k == ``Lean.Parser.Command.open
199 
200 private partial def splitMutualPreamble (elems : Array Syntax) : Option (Array Syntax × Array Syntax) :=
201   let rec loop (i : Nat) : Option (Array Syntax × Array Syntax) :=
202     if h : i < elems.size then
203       if isMutualPreambleCommand elems[i] then
204         loop (i+1)
205       else if i == 0 then
206         none -- `mutual` block does not contain any preamble commands
207       else
208         some (elems[*...i], elems[i...elems.size])
209     else
210       none -- a `mutual` block containing only preamble commands is not a valid `mutual` block
211   loop 0

213 /--
214 Find the common namespace for the given names.
215 Example:
216 ```
217 findCommonPrefix [`Lean.Elab.eval, `Lean.mkConst, `Lean.Elab.Tactic.evalTactic]
218 -- `Lean
219 ```
220 -/
221 def findCommonPrefix (ns : List Name) : Name :=
222   match ns with
223   | [] => .anonymous
224   | n :: ns => go n ns
225 where
226   go (n : Name) (ns : List Name) : Name :=
227     match n with
228     | .anonymous => .anonymous
229     | _ => match ns with
230       | [] => n
231       | n' :: ns => go (findCommon n.components n'.components) ns
232   findCommon (as bs : List Name) : Name :=
233     match as, bs with
234     | a :: as, b :: bs => if a == b then a ++ findCommon as bs else .anonymous
235     | _, _ => .anonymous
236

238 @[builtin_macro Lean.Parser.Command.mutual]
239 def expandMutualNamespace : Macro := fun stx => do
240   let mut nss := #[]
241   for elem in stx[1].getArgs do
242     match (← expandDeclNamespace? elem) with
243     | none        => Macro.throwUnsupported
244     | some (n, _) => nss := nss.push n
245   let common := findCommonPrefix nss.toList
246   if common.isAnonymous then Macro.throwUnsupported
247   let elemsNew ← stx[1].getArgs.mapM fun elem => do
248     let some name := getDeclName? elem | unreachable!
249     let view := extractMacroScopes name
250     let nameNew := { view with name := view.name.replacePrefix common .anonymous }.review
251     return setDeclName elem nameNew
252   let ns := mkIdentFrom stx common
253   let stxNew := stx.setArg 1 (mkNullNode elemsNew)
254   `(namespace $ns $(⟨stxNew⟩) end $ns)
255 
256 @[builtin_macro Lean.Parser.Command.mutual]
257 def expandMutualElement : Macro := fun stx => do
258   let mut elemsNew := #[]
259   let mut modified := false
260   for elem in stx[1].getArgs do
261     -- Don't trigger the `expandNamespacedDecl` macro, the namespace is handled by the mutual def
262     -- elaborator directly instead
263     if !elem.isOfKind ``Parser.Command.declaration then
264       if let some elemNew ← expandMacro? elem then
265         if elemNew.isOfKind nullKind then
266           elemsNew := elemsNew ++ elemNew.getArgs
267         else
268           elemsNew := elemsNew.push elemNew
269         modified := true
270         continue
271     elemsNew := elemsNew.push elem
272   if modified then
273     return stx.setArg 1 (mkNullNode elemsNew)
274   else
275     Macro.throwUnsupported
276 
277 @[builtin_macro Lean.Parser.Command.mutual]
278 def expandMutualPreamble : Macro := fun stx =>
279   match splitMutualPreamble stx[1].getArgs with
280   | none => Macro.throwUnsupported
281   | some (preamble, rest) => do
282     let secCmd    ← `(section)
283     let newMutual := stx.setArg 1 (mkNullNode rest)
284     let endCmd    ← `(end)
285     return mkNullNode (#[secCmd] ++ preamble ++ #[newMutual] ++ #[endCmd])
286 
287 @[builtin_command_elab «mutual», builtin_incremental]
288 def elabMutual : CommandElab := fun stx => do
289   withExporting (isExporting := (← getScope).isPublic) do
290   if isMutualDefLike stx then
291     -- only case implementing incrementality currently
292     elabMutualDef stx[1].getArgs
293   else withoutCommandIncrementality true do
294     if ← isMutualInductive stx then
295       elabMutualInductive stx[1].getArgs
296     else
297       throwError "invalid mutual block: either all elements of the block must be inductive/structure declarations, or they must all be definitions/theorems/abbrevs"
298 
299 /- leading_parser "attribute " >> "[" >> sepBy1 (eraseAttr <|> Term.attrInstance) ", " >> "]" >> many1 ident -/
300 @[builtin_command_elab «attribute»] def elabAttr : CommandElab := fun stx => do
301   let mut attrInsts := #[]
302   let mut toErase := #[]
303   for attrKindStx in stx[2].getSepArgs do
304     if attrKindStx.getKind == ``Lean.Parser.Command.eraseAttr then
305       let attrName := attrKindStx[1].getId.eraseMacroScopes
306       if isAttribute (← getEnv) attrName then
307         toErase := toErase.push attrName
308       else
309         logErrorAt attrKindStx m!"unknown attribute [{attrName}]"
310     else
311       attrInsts := attrInsts.push attrKindStx
312   let attrs ← elabAttrs attrInsts
313   let idents := stx[4].getArgs
314   for ident in idents do withRef ident <| liftTermElabM do
315     /-
316     HACK to allow `attribute` command to disable builtin simprocs.
317     TODO: find a better solution. Example: have some "fake" declaration
318     for builtin simprocs.
319     -/
320     let declNames ←
321       try
322         realizeGlobalConstWithInfos ident
323       catch _ =>
324         let name := ident.getId.eraseMacroScopes
325         if (← Simp.isBuiltinSimproc name) then
326           pure [name]
327         else
328           throwUnknownConstantAt ident name
329     let declName ← ensureNonAmbiguous ident declNames
330     withExporting (isExporting := !isPrivateName declName && attrs.any (·.kind != .local)) do
331       recordExtraModUseFromDecl (isMeta := false) declName
332     Term.applyAttributes declName attrs
333     for attrName in toErase do
334       Attribute.erase declName attrName
335     if (← getEnv).isImportedConst declName then
336       if let some attr := attrs.find? (·.kind != .local) then
337         -- If an imported declaration is marked with a non-local attribute, Shake must be informed
338         -- about this indirect reference
339         recordIndirectModUse attr.name.toString declName
340 
341 @[builtin_command_elab Lean.Parser.Command.«initialize»] def elabInitialize : CommandElab
342   | stx@`($declModifiers:declModifiers $kw:initializeKeyword $[$id? : $type? ←]? $doSeq) => do
343     let attrId := mkIdentFrom stx <| if kw.raw[0].isToken "initialize" then `init else `builtin_init
344     if let (some id, some type) := (id?, type?) then
345       let `(Parser.Command.declModifiersT| $[$doc?:docComment]? $[@[$attrs?,*]]? $(vis?)? $[meta%$meta?]? $[unsafe%$unsafe?]?) := stx[0]
346         | throwErrorAt declModifiers "invalid initialization command, unexpected modifiers"
347       let defStx ← `($[$doc?:docComment]? @[$attrId:ident initFn, $(attrs?.getD ∅),*] $(vis?)? $[meta%$meta?]? opaque $id : $type)
348       let mut fullId := (← getCurrNamespace) ++ id.getId
349       if vis?.any (·.raw.isOfKind ``Parser.Command.private) then
350         fullId := mkPrivateName (← getEnv) fullId
351       -- We need to add `id`'s ranges *before* elaborating `initFn` (and then `id` itself) as
352       -- otherwise the info context created by `with_decl_name` will be incomplete and break the
353       -- call hierarchy
354       addDeclarationRangesForBuiltin fullId ⟨defStx.raw[0]⟩ defStx.raw[1]
355       let vis := Parser.Command.visibility.ofBool (!isPrivateName fullId)
356       elabCommand (← `(
357         $vis:visibility $[meta%$meta?]? $[unsafe%$unsafe?]? def initFn : IO $type := with_decl_name% $(mkIdent fullId) do $doSeq
358         $defStx:command))
359     else
360       let `(Parser.Command.declModifiersT| $[$doc?:docComment]? $[@[$attrs?,*]]? $(_)? $[meta%$meta?]? $[unsafe%$unsafe?]?) := declModifiers
361         | throwErrorAt declModifiers "invalid initialization command, unexpected modifiers"
362       let attrs := (attrs?.map (·.getElems)).getD #[]
363       let attrs := attrs.push (← `(Lean.Parser.Term.attrInstance| $attrId:ident))
364       -- `[builtin_init]` can be private as it is used for local codegen only but `[init]` must be
365       -- available for the interpreter.
366       let vis := Parser.Command.visibility.ofBool (attrId.getId == `init)
367       elabCommand (← `($[$doc?:docComment]? @[$[$attrs],*] $vis:visibility $[meta%$meta?]? $[unsafe%$unsafe?]? def initFn : IO Unit := do $doSeq))
368   | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
